EquipmentProfile.title: EquipmentProfile
EquipmentProfile.description: Represents a registered mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, computer controller (PLC/ECU/CNC), or computer asset.

name.description: Display name of the equipment or system.

systemCategory.description: Primary engineering domain of the equipment.

environmentType.description: Operational environment (e.g., Heavy Industrial, Marine, Data Center, Automotive, Manufacturing).

notes.description: Configuration notes, firmware version, or maintenance history summary.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DiagnosticSession.title: DiagnosticSession
DiagnosticSession.description: Multimodal AI diagnostic report and step-by-step repair guide tailored to a specific equipment model and environment.

environmentType.description: Operating environment where the failure occurred.

symptomDescription.description: User prompt describing symptoms, fault codes, noises, or behaviors.

attachedMediaSummary.description: Summary of multimodal inputs analyzed (images, audio acoustic profile, video frames).

severity.description: Urgency and hazard level of the failure.

technicalAnalysis.description: Detailed engineering breakdown of why the failure occurred.

safetyWarnings.description: Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), depressurization, ESD, or high-voltage safety precautions.

requiredTools.description: Tools, gauges, software utilities, and replacement parts needed.

completedStepIndices.description: Indices of repair steps completed by the technician.

verificationTest.description: Post-repair test procedure to confirm nominal operation.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the repair session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

TroubleshootingFlowchart.title: TroubleshootingFlowchart
TroubleshootingFlowchart.description: Interactive conditional yes/no decision tree for isolating failures across mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, computer controller, and computer systems.

title.description: Title of the interactive troubleshooting flowchart.

failureMode.description: Common failure symptom being narrowed down.

currentNodeId.description: ID of the active decision or conclusion node in the walkthrough.

visitedPathSummary.description: Breadcrumb log of Yes/No observations recorded so far.

nodesList.description: Ordered list of decision/conclusion nodes encoded as 'nodeId::nodeType::prompt::hint::yesNodeId::noNodeId::action'.

isResolved.description: Whether the user has reached a root cause conclusion.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/equipment/{equipmentId}.description: Stores user-owned equipment profiles across all 6 system domains.

/diagnostics/{diagnosticId}.description: Stores multimodal diagnostic sessions and step-by-step repair guides.

/flowcharts/{flowchartId}.description: Stores interactive yes/no troubleshooting flowcharts and walkthrough states.
